# hibira_approvals_workspace (Resource)

A [Hibira Approvals](https://hibira.io/approvals) workspace: the people who answer approval requests from agents and workflows, their roles and approver groups. The API token acts as its owner's email (which must be verified): a new workspace makes that email its admin, and an existing one can be managed only by its admins. Each workspace has its own app (`app_id`); tools connect to it with `npx -y @hibira-io/mcp-approval-gate login` or the app's keys in the workspace's Settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hibira_approvals_workspace" "ops" {
  name = "Ops approvals"

  members = [
    { email = "you@example.com", role = "admin" }, # the API token's owner
    { email = "dba-lead@example.com", role = "approver" },
    { email = "auditor@example.com", role = "viewer" },
  ]

  groups = [
    { slug = "dba", name = "DBAs", members = ["dba-lead@example.com"] },
  ]
}

# Agents and workflows send requests through the workspace's app; connect
# a tool with `npx -y @hibira-io/mcp-approval-gate login`.
output "approvals_app_id" {
  value = hibira_approvals_workspace.ops.app_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The workspace's name, 1 to 60 characters.

### Optional

- `groups` (Attributes List) Approver groups: a request sent to a group's `slug` (for example `approvers: ["dba"]`) can be answered only by its members. Unset: managed on approvals.hibira.io. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `members` (Attributes Set) Everyone in the workspace. Include the token owner's email as an `admin`: Terraform would otherwise remove its own access. Unset: members are managed on approvals.hibira.io and only read here. The plan limits how many admins and approvers there can be; viewers are free. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

### Read-Only

- `app_id` (String) The workspace's own app, which requests are sent through.
- `id` (String) The workspace's ID (`apw_...`).
- `plan` (String) The workspace's plan (`free`, `starter`, `team`, `business`, `enterprise`). Changed on approvals.hibira.io.

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Required:

- `members` (Set of String) Members' emails (they must be in the workspace), 1 to 50.
- `name` (String) Shown in the inbox.
- `slug` (String) The group's ID in requests: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, at most 40.


<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Required:

- `email` (String) The person's email, in lowercase. They sign in to approvals.hibira.io with it.
- `role` (String) `admin` (settings, members, keys), `approver` (answers requests) or `viewer` (sees them).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hibira_approvals_workspace.ops apw_0123456789abcdef
```
